title: ValueError while running a bulk import (form.submit)
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.1.5; operating system Fedora 41
Workstation; server region us-east-1.

Steps

To replicate:
- Open Lattice and begin running a bulk import.
- Enter an amount with eight decimal places.
- Observe the journal for the traceback beneath.

Expected

Expected running a bulk import to finish without errors.

Actual

It fails on a decimal value with many digits after the
point. The decimal values that fail all have seven or more
fractional digits.

Frequency

It occurs two times this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:92 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:54 in run_import
lattice/ui/form.py:257 in submit
ValueError: invalid date '2026-03-29 02:30'
